scope: Exact prior fallback building models and measured source crowns retained through the finite Pasaj source-return expansion. No physical clearance, surveyed height, route or native pass is implied.

inferredBuildingModels.basis: Retain the identical-source prior fallback MODEL. Newly admitted road proximity supplies no new building height/style evidence. Roof tags/research and literal dimensions still win.
